readme:
# TikTok Video Scraper

Pass in TikTok usernames or profile URLs, get back their recent videos with engagement metrics, hashtags, music, and embedded author metadata. No login, no API key, no cookies on your end.

Pairs naturally with our [TikTok Profile Scraper](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/tiktok-profile-scraper): use profile-scraper to discover and pipe creators, use this one to deep-scrape their content.

## What you get

For every profile you pass in, the scraper fetches their recent videos via TikTok's signed web API. About **30 fields per video** including:

- Video ID, URL, caption text, language
- Created-at timestamp (ISO 8601 + unix)
- Duration, slideshow / pinned / ad flags
- Engagement: play, like, comment, share, save counts
- Hashtags + mentions parsed from the caption
- Music metadata (track ID, title, artist, original-sound flag, audio URL)
- Media URLs (video MP4 stream, cover image) + dimensions
- Embedded author block (username, user ID, sec UID, display name, verified, follower count)

## Input

```json
{
  "profiles": ["mrbeast", "tiktok"],
  "maxVideosPerProfile": 30
}
```

Usernames can be plain (`mrbeast`), at-prefixed (`@mrbeast`), or full URLs (`https://www.tiktok.com/@mrbeast`). All three normalize to the same thing.

### Available input fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `profiles` | array | required | Usernames, @handles, or profile URLs |
| `maxVideosPerProfile` | integer | 30 | Number of recent videos to return per profile. Paginates in pages of 30. |
| `maxIPRotations` | integer | 5 | How many times to retry with a fresh session if TikTok soft-blocks |
| `proxyConfiguration` | object | RESIDENTIAL | Apify proxy. Residential is required — TikTok rejects datacenter IPs on the protected endpoint. |

## Output

One item per video.

```json
{
  "id": "7412345678901234567",
  "url": "https://www.tiktok.com/@mrbeast/video/7412345678901234567",
  "text": "I gave away $1,000,000 today",
  "language": "en",

  "created_at_unix": 1734287400,
  "duration_sec": 30,
  "is_pinned": false,
  "is_slideshow": false,
  "is_ad": false,
  "engagement": {
    "play_count": 158300000,
    "like_count": 12000000,
    "comment_count": 230000,
    "share_count": 890000,

  },

  "mentions": [],
  "music": {
    "id": "7412345600000000001",
    "title": "original sound - MrBeast",
    "author_name": "MrBeast",
    "original": true,
    "url": "https://..."
  },
  "media": {
    "video_url": "https://v16-webapp...",
    "cover_url": "https://p16-sign-va...",
    "width": 1080,
    "height": 1920
  },
  "author": {
    "username": "mrbeast",
    "user_id": "6614519312189947909",
    "sec_uid": "MS4wLjABAAAABKjQkOz_IIzXXzEAl_9LGsWhvK-gBnlczwRPXK8EmxAp6K3X0qiaP5_OEqmm0XwG",
    "display_name": "MrBeast",
    "verified": true,

```

### A few notes about the fields

- `media.video_url` and `media.cover_url` are signed URLs that TikTok rotates regularly. Treat them as short-lived (~hours, not days). Download what you need promptly.
- `engagement` counts are snapshots — they grow over time on viral videos. Re-scrape if you need fresh numbers.
- `language` is TikTok's auto-detected caption language, not a regional setting.
- `hashtags` and `mentions` are pulled from both the `challenges` array and the caption `textExtra` markers — usually consistent but we deduplicate either way.
- `is_ad` is TikTok's own paid-promotion flag — only `true` when the creator declared a partnership in the platform.
- `author.follower_count` is the latest count from the creator's profile page at scrape time, not at video-post time.
- If you want richer profile data per author (bio, link in bio, account creation timestamp, TikTok Shop seller flag), feed those usernames into our [TikTok Profile Scraper](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/tiktok-profile-scraper) — that's its specialty.

## Examples

**Three creators, 20 videos each**
```json
{"profiles": ["mrbeast", "khaby.lame", "tiktok"], "maxVideosPerProfile": 20}
```

**Single profile, paginate to 200 videos**
```json
{"profiles": ["mrbeast"], "maxVideosPerProfile": 200}
```

**Brand panel for content marketing research**
```json
{
  "profiles": ["nike", "adidas", "newbalance", "puma"],
  "maxVideosPerProfile": 50,
  "proxyConfiguration": {
    "useApifyProxy": true,
    "apifyProxyGroups": ["RESIDENTIAL"]
  }
}
```

## Pricing

Pay per result.

| Event | Price |
|---|---|
| Actor start | $0.020 |
| Each video delivered | $0.001 |

The higher start fee covers a one-time msToken handshake with TikTok (signed-API access). After that it's a flat $1.00 per 1,000 videos — substantially cheaper than the dominant competitor, with comparable field coverage.

Some quick math:

- 30 videos (one profile) = **$0.05** total
- 300 videos (10 profiles × 30) = **$0.32** total
- 1,000 videos = **$1.02** total

No monthly fees. No minimum spend. You only pay for videos the scraper actually delivers — failed pages don't count.

## How to use it from an AI agent

The actor is exposed on Apify's MCP endpoint:

```
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/tiktok-video-scraper
```

This works with Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, and any other MCP client.

Example prompt:

> Use tiktok-video-scraper to get the 50 most recent videos from @mrbeast and @khaby.lame. Show me a table sorted by play count, with caption text, hashtags, and engagement counts.

## Caveats

- Only public accounts return videos. Private accounts return an error.
- Residential proxy is required. Datacenter IPs are silently rejected by the TikTok API.
- TikTok occasionally rotates their signing keys and protected-endpoint policies; the scraper rotates sessions and retries on soft-blocks, but very rare endpoint changes may need an actor update.
- Video and cover URLs expire after a few hours. Download what you need promptly.
